mcqs.question:
With reference to PM-eBus Sewa, consider the following statements:
Statement A: PM-eBus Sewa promotes green mobility in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities through a non-PPP model.
Statement B: Andhra Pradesh received an allocation of 750 fully air-conditioned electric buses under the scheme.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because PM-eBus Sewa promotes green mobility in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities through PPP. Statement B is true: Andhra Pradesh was allocated 750 fully air-conditioned electric buses under the scheme.
